description: This file defines a PHP interface 'ValueYModifiable' within the OrangeHRM project, specifically under the namespace OrangeHRM\Core\Report\FilterField. The interface declares a method 'yValueModifier' intended for classes that implement it to modify or prepare a 'y' value (which can be a string or null) for persistence.

classes.name: ValueYModifiable
classes.description: A PHP interface that mandates implementing classes to define a method for modifying 'y' values for persistence.

methods.name: yValueModifier
methods.description: Method to implement how the 'y' value (string or null) should be prepared or modified before persisting.

methods.name: yValueModifier
methods.description: Defines the contract for modifying the 'y' value; accepts a nullable string and returns a nullable string.
